rows.notes: One notice only. Dating: the Reuters brief (source_time 28 Jul) says P66 'reported on Tuesday' (28 Jul 2026 is a Tuesday); the scorer_notes and the prediction claim call the filing 'dated 27 July' (the event date). The record never shows the filing's own date because STEERS was unreachable, so date_arrived uses the dated document the record does hold (28 Jul, one day after the clock). If the filing is taken to be dated 27 Jul it would fall on the clock and be excluded as before_clock. Coverage caution for the orchestrator: the linked resolution 01a07c42-3a85-719b-8f3c-6bd6da154de5 carries source_coverage 'adequate', but its scorer_note says the filing's own page was unreachable and its existence is established only by the wire that quotes it; the map (01a07c42-3a84-743b-b3fb-d956d0e157c8) and lag_band (01a07c42-3a85-719b-8f3c-6bdbd7843605) resolutions, which name the TCEQ report as their carrier, are both 'thin'. Issuer alternative: the plant holder 'Phillips 66 Sweeny Refinery' (01a07c3e-5cb5-75d4-a348-2fc3febe419c, kind plant, parent Phillips 66) is the TCEQ-facing entity in the touched set; the wire names Phillips 66 as the reporter. All eight touched_set rows sit on the event node sweeny_refinery_output. Round 8 has no resolution or evidence row on any other notice kind.

rows.notes: No forced notice arrived after the clock in the v15 record for this round. The only forced-shaped items (the shelter-in-place order and its extension and lift, the school closure, the rail shutdown, the JOIFF incident page) are all dated 12 Aug, the event date itself, so under the after-the-clock rule they are listed under excluded as before_clock rather than counted. If the orchestrator wants a same-day variant, those are the candidates (issuers: St. Clair County emergency management and East St. Louis District 189; obligation would be emergency-response authority, plausibly doubtful). The operator's own coverage record found nothing from any producer, importer or distributor, but its coverage was thin (trade press through search only, ICIS closed, USCG sector page, RiverBender, HazardEx and FOX 2 returned 403, NRC FOIA not searched), so absence here is a limit of the record, not proof that nothing arrived. Events node us_trichlor_supply; touched_set has 15 rows across us_trichlor_supply and sauget_industrial_corridor_access, and no notice sits on either. Resolution 01a08001-a2b6-767f-af61-5678ddd9371c is a human ruling that supersedes the operator's miss on the USCG call.
